title: Muzammil Shaheen
subTitle: eBay Store Case Study
summary: Mr. Muzammil Shaheen started working with us in August 2024. We set up and managed his eBay account from the beginning with an initial investment of $100.

In the first 3-4 months, the store began making around $1,000 profit per month. After 6-7 months, the profit increased to $2,000-$3,000 per month, with monthly sales of $10,000-$15,000. Some months even reached $5,000 in profit.
So far, the store has generated $45,000+ in total profit with a total investment of around $5,000. The business is still running strong, following all eBay rules and keeping the account healthy.
